sentences.en: Wrestling was the most popular organized sport in Ancient Greece.
sentences.zh: 古希腊最受欢迎的职业体育项目是摔跤。

sentences.en: He bet her that he could beat her at arm wrestling.
sentences.zh: 他打赌自己能在臂力对抗中赢她。

sentences.en: She bet him that she could beat him at arm wrestling.
sentences.zh: 她打赌自己能在臂力对抗中赢他。

senses.zh: 与摔跤；与…搏斗；使劲搬动
